source_scope.source_detail_limit: The prototype mixes template definitions, campaigns, acquisition attempts, issued entitlements, refund observations and allowance/funding evidence. Amounts are often JSON or generic strings, creator fields are misspelled, status dictionaries are absent and refund rows do not identify the original Order allocation.

verification_policy.specified_definition: Each coupon source has same-name DDL evidence plus explicit template/campaign/entitlement/application/funding authority, identity, units, history, security, corrections and runtime gate.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Verification requires non-empty production evidence and full-denominator tenant-scoped independent reconciliation through entitlement, Order allocation and reversal lineage.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Version Campaign and Template definitions; append acquisition, issuance, reservation, use, return, expiry and funding observations as immutable facts.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Source deletion retires mutable visibility but never erases issued entitlement, Order benefit allocation, funding or reversal history.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant, Principal, Merchant, Campaign, Template version, Entitlement, Order/Item allocation and source dictionaries before replay; quarantine ambiguous amounts, statuses, funders, or orphan returns.
